summary: Iteration 25 — Regression sweep after main-agent added device safe-area bottom padding to every bottom sheet / modal action area. VERDICT: CLEAN — all safe-area sheet fixes look correct.  (a) Full overflow sweep re-run (/app/test_reports/iter24_overflow_sweep.py, 29 routes × 6 viewports = 174 checks) still 0 horizontal-overflow / 0 bottom-unreachable / 0 tab-bar-clipping / 0 load-failed / 0 console-errors — see /app/test_reports/iter24_overflow_results.json.  (b) Dedicated bottom-sheet probe (/app/test_reports/iter25_sheets_test.py) opened 15 sheet variants at 390×844: 9 explicit sheets confirmed OK with sheet-bottom exactly at viewport edge and the last interactive button inside the viewport — chats-more-sheet (last btn chats-more-notif, bottom 810 ≤ vh 844), moments-custom-filter (mcf-search bottom 820), moment_compose topic sheet (compose-tags-done inside), premium/connect Teach-on-Premium apply sheet (premium-apply-done inside), and all 5 learn/set-goal picker sheets (level/time/reason/weekly/minutes — every last option row inside viewport). The onboarding language-picker sheet reported ACTION_BUTTON_CLIPPED but this is a FALSE POSITIVE from the probe: the sheet contains an inner ScrollView (maxHeight: 360) so language rows past index ~7 are intentionally scrollable inside the sheet — the sheet container itself is correctly positioned (bottom=844=vh) with paddingBottom = 30 + insets.bottom (learn/onboarding.tsx:229). 4 sheets skipped as OPENER_NOT_FOUND (see notes): admin-tab-more (admin login state not reached inside probe / no overflow tabs at 390w), dob-year/month/day (DateOfBirthPicker only mounts once the 'Birthday' editor field is opened, not on plain /edit-profile load), and wotd-card (dashboard may hide the card if already claimed for the day). All four use the same `paddingBottom: <base> + insets.bottom` pattern verified in the working sheets — no regression risk expected.  (c) 1-to-1 call smoke (mei→diego, two fake-media Chromium contexts): PASSED — chat-call-btn tap → B receives call-overlay + call-accept-btn → B accepts → both A and B show call-timer (Connected) → end-call clears both overlays cleanly (see /app/test_reports/iter25_call.log). Only console noise on either side is the pre-existing benign 'Unexpected text node' RN-web warning; no new errors introduced by the safe-area edits.  Deprecated packages / SafeAreaView issues detected: NONE new.  Overall: the second wave of safe-area bottom padding edits is regression-clean; no new bugs.
action_items: (Informational, not a bug) The onboarding language-picker sheet renders a full-height list via an inner <ScrollView style={{maxHeight:360}}> (app/learn/onboarding.tsx:237). Automated probes that only measure the last child bounding-box will report those hidden-below-fold list items as 'clipped' even though the sheet container itself is sized correctly. If future tests want to validate this sheet, they should scroll the ScrollView first before checking the last row.

(Test-side, not a bug) Coverage gaps in this iteration due to opener not being reachable inside the automated probe (all four sheets use the SAME paddingBottom: base + insets.bottom pattern that already passed on the sibling sheets, so risk is low but they were not directly verified this iteration): (1) admin-more-sheet — admin-tab-more only mounts when hasOverflow is true and the automated admin login inside the probe did not complete before the opener query; verify by logging into /admin-x7k2p9 as admin@lingua.app / Admin1234! at 390w and tapping the '…' tab. (2) DateOfBirthPicker sheets — testIDs dob-year/month/day-btn only mount while the 'Birthday' editor field is open on /edit-profile; open the field first, then tap Year/Month/Day. (3) WordOfDay sheet (wotd-card → wotd-sheet) — the card is conditionally rendered on /learn/dashboard when a Word-of-Day exists and has not yet been claimed for the day.

(Informational, unchanged from iter24) Chat send button (chat-send-btn) is only rendered while the composer has non-empty text — probe with wait_for_selector, not query_selector, when writing future tests.
critical_code_review_comments: All 27 sheet/modal action containers found via grep 'paddingBottom.*insets.bottom' consistently use the correct pattern of `<base> + insets.bottom` (base ranges 12-64 depending on sheet). This is the correct fix that clears iOS home-indicator (34pt) and Android nav-bar without double-adding when the sheet is already inside a safe-area context.
